in_sanskrit.name: Emolic
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Love and Compassion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Emolic एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ema’ (Goddess) and ‘Lilas’ (Divine play or Love), Emolic represents the embodiment of divine love and compassion. In Hindu mythology, Emolic is revered as the goddess of love, relationships, and marital bliss.
